277      async def resolve_agent_version(
  278          self, context: WorkspaceExecutionContext, thread_id: UUID
  279      ) -> tuple[AgentThread, UUID]:
  280          """Find the version this thread's next turn should run against.
  281  
  282          The thread stores an agent, not a version. Resolving at submission time
  283          is what lets a long thread pick up a newer published version, and what
  284          keeps the run — not the thread — the reproducible unit.
  285          """
  286  
  287          workspace_id = _require(context, AGENT_RUN)
  288          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  289              thread = await self._load(session, workspace_id, thread_id)
  290              version_id = await session.scalar(
  291                  select(AgentVersion.id)
  292                  .where(
  293                      AgentVersion.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  294                      AgentVersion.agent_id == thread.agent_id,
  295                  )
  296                  .order_by(AgentVersion.version_number.desc())
  297                  .limit(1)
  298              )
  299              if version_id is None:
  300                  raise AgentHubError(
  301                      "AGENT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND",
  302                      "The agent has no published version to run.",
  303                      409,
  304                  )
  305              session.expunge(thread)
  306              return thread, version_id

62      async def resolve_chain(
   63          self,
   64          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
   65          profile_id: UUID,
   66          *,
   67          required_capabilities: CapabilityRequirements | None = None,
   68      ) -> tuple[ResolvedModelProfile, ...]:

   70          chain: list[ResolvedModelProfile] = []
   71          visited: set[UUID] = set()
   72          current_id: UUID | None = profile_id
   73  
   74          while current_id is not None:
   75              if current_id in visited:
   76                  raise ModelGatewayError(ModelGatewayErrorCode.MODEL_BAD_RESPONSE)
   77              visited.add(current_id)
   78              profile = await self.repository.get_model_profile(context, current_id)
   79              if profile is None or profile.enabled is False:
   80                  raise ModelGatewayError(ModelGatewayErrorCode.MODEL_PROFILE_DISABLED)
   81              resolved = _to_resolved(profile)
   82              validate_capabilities(resolved.capabilities, required)
   83              chain.append(resolved)
   84              current_id = resolved.fallback_profile_id
   85  
   86          return tuple(chain)

595  def compare_metric_values(
  596      baseline: MetricValue,
  597      candidate: MetricValue,
  598      *,
  599      direction: MetricDirection,
  600      paired: Sequence[tuple[float | None, float | None]] = (),
  601  ) -> PairedMetric:
  602      baseline_value = _float_value(baseline)
  603      candidate_value = _float_value(candidate)
  604      absolute = (
  605          candidate_value - baseline_value
  606          if baseline_value is not None and candidate_value is not None
  607          else None
  608      )
  609      relative = (
  610          absolute / baseline_value
  611          if absolute is not None and baseline_value not in {None, 0}
  612          else None
  613      )
  614      wins = ties = losses = missing = 0
  615      for before, after in paired:
  616          if before is None or after is None:
  617              missing += 1
  618              continue
  619          if after == before:
  620              ties += 1
  621          elif (after > before) == (direction == MetricDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER):
  622              wins += 1
  623          else:
  624              losses += 1
  625      status = "COMPLETE"
  626      reason = None
  627      if direction == MetricDirection.UNKNOWN:
  628          status = "NOT_COMPARABLE"
  629          reason = "unknown_metric_direction"
  630      elif baseline.status != MetricStatus.AVAILABLE or candidate.status != MetricStatus.AVAILABLE:
  631          status = "NOT_COMPARABLE"
  632          reason = "metric_not_available"
  633      elif not paired or wins + ties + losses == 0:
  634          status = "NOT_COMPARABLE"
  635          reason = "no_applicable_pairs"
  636      elif missing:
  637          status = "INCOMPLETE"
  638          reason = "missing_metric_observations"
  639      if status == "NOT_COMPARABLE":
  640          absolute = None
  641          relative = None
  642      return PairedMetric(
  643          baseline=baseline,
  644          candidate=candidate,
  645          absolute_delta=absolute,
  646          relative_delta=relative,
  647          paired_win=wins,
  648          paired_tie=ties,
  649          paired_loss=losses,
  650          applicable_pairs=wins + ties + losses,
  651          missing_pairs=missing,
  652          direction=direction,
  653          status=status,
  654          reason=reason,
  655      )

1  """Reading and writing long-term memory.
    2  
    3  Selection is deliberately dumb: term overlap, then salience, then recency, over
    4  an agent's few dozen active rows. There is no embedding index here and there is
    5  no plan for one until the row count makes scanning expensive, because an
    6  unexplainable recall is worse than a slow one -- see
    7  ``docs/adr/ADR-011-memory-must-be-snapshotted.md``.
    8  
    9  Writing is where the care is. Everything in this module's write path treats the
   10  incoming statement as untrusted text produced by a model: it is length-checked,
   11  kind-checked, hashed, deduplicated, and capped per turn before it is allowed to
   12  become something a future run will read.
   13  """
   14  
   15  from __future__ import annotations
   16  
   17  from datetime import UTC, datetime
   18  from uuid import UUID, uuid4
   19  
   20  from sqlalchemy import func, or_, select, text, update
   21  from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
   22  from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker
   23  
   24  from packages.core.text import search_terms
   25  from packages.memory.contracts import (
   26      MAX_EVIDENCE_LENGTH,
   27      MAX_MEMORIES_PER_TURN,
   28      MAX_MEMORY_LENGTH,
   29      MIN_MEMORY_LENGTH,
   30      MemoryCandidate,
   31      MemorySnapshotIntegrityError,
   32      SelectedMemory,
   33      memory_content_hash,
   34  )
   35  from packages.memory.models import MEMORY_KINDS, MemoryContribution, WorkspaceMemory
   36  
   37  ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
   38  SUPERSEDED = "SUPERSEDED"
   39  INVALIDATED = "INVALIDATED"
   40  
   41  # Ranking weights. A term hit is worth more than a reinforcement, because a
   42  # memory that is about the current question beats a memory that is merely
   43  # popular; salience only breaks ties among equally relevant rows.
   44  _TERM_WEIGHT = 100
   45  
   46  
   47  def content_hash(content: str) -> str:
   48      """Identity of a statement, insensitive to whitespace and letter case.
   49  
   50      Two extractions of the same fact rarely agree on punctuation. Hashing the
   51      normalized form is what turns "the team prefers short answers" arriving
   52      twice into one row with salience 2 rather than two rows that will both be
   53      injected and waste the budget saying the same thing.
   54      """
   55  
   56      return memory_content_hash(content)
   57  
   58  
   59  def _selected(row: WorkspaceMemory) -> SelectedMemory:
   60      return SelectedMemory(
   61          id=row.id,
   62          kind=row.kind,
   63          content=row.content,
   64          salience=row.salience,
   65          content_hash=row.content_hash,
   66      )
   67  
   68  
   69  def normalize_candidate(candidate: MemoryCandidate) -> MemoryCandidate | None:
   70      """Apply the write gate to one proposed statement, or refuse it.
   71  
   72      Returning ``None`` rather than raising is intentional: the extractor is a
   73      model, a model will occasionally propose rubbish, and one bad candidate in
   74      a batch of three must not cost the other two.
   75      """
   76  
   77      content = " ".join((candidate.content or "").split())
   78      if not MIN_MEMORY_LENGTH <= len(content) <= MAX_MEMORY_LENGTH:
   79          return None
   80      kind = (candidate.kind or "FACT").strip().upper()
   81      if kind not in MEMORY_KINDS:
   82          return None
   83      if candidate.evidence is not None and (
   84          not isinstance(candidate.evidence, str)
   85          or not candidate.evidence
   86          or len(candidate.evidence) > MAX_EVIDENCE_LENGTH
   87      ):
   88          return None
   89      return MemoryCandidate(content=content, kind=kind, evidence=candidate.evidence)
   90  
   91  
   92  class SqlAlchemyMemoryStore:
   93      def __init__(self, session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]) -> None:
   94          self.session_factory = session_factory
   95  
   96      # -- read ------------------------------------------------------------
   97  
   98      async def select(
   99          self, *, workspace_id: UUID, agent_id: UUID, query: str, limit: int
  100      ) -> tuple[SelectedMemory, ...]:
  101          if limit <= 0:
  102              return ()
  103          terms = search_terms(query)
  104          now = datetime.now(UTC)
  105          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  106              rows = (
  107                  await session.scalars(
  108                      select(WorkspaceMemory)
  109                      .where(
  110                          WorkspaceMemory.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  111                          WorkspaceMemory.agent_id == agent_id,
  112                          WorkspaceMemory.status == ACTIVE,
  113                          or_(
  114                              WorkspaceMemory.expires_at.is_(None),
  115                              WorkspaceMemory.expires_at > now,
  116                          ),
  117                      )
  118                      .order_by(WorkspaceMemory.created_at.desc())
  119                  )
  120              ).all()
  121          scored = sorted(
  122              rows,
  123              key=lambda row: (
  124                  -_TERM_WEIGHT * _matches(row.content, terms),
  125                  -row.salience,
  126                  -row.created_at.timestamp(),
  127              ),
  128          )
  129          return tuple(_selected(row) for row in scored[:limit])
  130  
  131      async def load(
  132          self,
  133          *,
  134          workspace_id: UUID,
  135          memory_ids: tuple[UUID, ...],
  136          memory_content_hashes: dict[UUID | str, str] | None = None,
  137      ) -> tuple[SelectedMemory, ...]:
  138          """Re-read a frozen selection, in the order it was frozen.
  139  
  140          A run replaying its own snapshot must see what it saw, including rows
  141          that have since been superseded or invalidated: the snapshot records
  142          what the model was told, and rewriting history to be tidier would make
  143          the run log a worse answer to "why did it say that" than it is now.
  144          """
  145  
  146          if not memory_ids:
  147              if memory_content_hashes:
  148                  raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  149                      "The frozen memory snapshot contains unexpected content hashes."
  150                  )
  151              return ()
  152          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  153              rows = (
  154                  await session.scalars(
  155                      select(WorkspaceMemory).where(
  156                          WorkspaceMemory.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  157                          WorkspaceMemory.id.in_(memory_ids),
  158                      )
  159                  )
  160              ).all()
  161          by_id = {row.id: row for row in rows}
  162          if memory_content_hashes is None:
  163              # ID-only snapshots predate hash freezing and remain replayable.
  164              return tuple(_selected(by_id[key]) for key in memory_ids if key in by_id)
  165          if len(set(memory_ids)) != len(memory_ids) or len(by_id) != len(set(memory_ids)):
  166              raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  167                  "The frozen memory snapshot references a missing or duplicate memory."
  168              )
  169          expected_keys = {str(key) for key in memory_content_hashes}
  170          if expected_keys != {str(key) for key in memory_ids}:
  171              raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  172                  "The frozen memory snapshot hash set does not match its memory ids."
  173              )
  174          selected: list[SelectedMemory] = []
  175          for key in memory_ids:
  176              row = by_id.get(key)
  177              expected = memory_content_hashes.get(key) or memory_content_hashes.get(str(key))
  178              if row is None or not isinstance(expected, str) or row.content_hash != expected:
  179                  raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  180                      "The frozen memory snapshot does not match the stored memory."

1  # Wiki 独立验收与使用
    2  
    3  调研：[研究与选型](research-and-selection.md)、[上游源码走查](upstream-research.md)。
    4  契约：[ADR-012](../adr/ADR-012-versioned-derived-wiki.md)。结果：[验收报告](acceptance.md)。
    5  2026-10-25 已与最新 RAG `fb62b57` 并轨；当前状态、测试和边界见
    6  [并轨验收](integration-acceptance.md)，后续遵循 [并轨制度](integration-plan.md)。
    7  
    8  ## 部署
    9  
   10  只在本分支/集成环境执行部署迁移：`python -m alembic upgrade head`，head 为 `0033_wiki_source_revocation`。
   11  启动现有 API、Celery worker 和 beat。worker 增加 `apps.worker.tasks.wiki`，beat 每分钟对账。
   12  API 不创建 schema。编译资料来自已入库 READY 的原始 DocumentRevision/DocumentChunk，不额外上传到外部 Wiki 服务。
   13  模型调用仍通过现有已配置模型网关；没有加入新默认模型或暗中替换模型。
   14  
   15  ## API 操作顺序
   16  
   17  所有请求使用现有登录会话/访问 token 与 workspace membership。
   18  以下路径前缀 `B=/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/knowledge-bases/{knowledge_base_id}/wiki`。
   19  
   20  1. 上传资料、等待既有知识入库 READY，然后 `POST B/compilations`：
   21  
   22     ```json
   23     {"model_profile_id":"<UUID>","source_snapshot_id":"LATEST","output_mode":"PROMPT_JSON"}
   24     ```
   25  
   26     返回 202 与 durable job ID。相同来源和编译规格返回同一个 ID。可以改用显式 source snapshot UUID。
   27     JSON_SCHEMA 模式要求模型声明原生 structured_output；PROMPT_JSON 使用普通文本生成，但本地严格 schema 与来源检查相同。
   28     模型必须配置已知 context 上限。提示/输出schema/模型计划/endpoint身份均固定，升级不静默改变旧任务。
   29     默认 `review_mode=BASIC`，只运行确定性检查，不自动调用实验性跨来源模型复核。
   30     显式 `review_mode=MODEL` 或只指定 `review_model_profile_id` 才启用模型复核；后者可指定独立配置。
   31     两套模型计划和路由分别冻结，复核 profile 的预算变化不重提取未变来源；系统不暗中提高用户的 max_tokens。
   32  
   33  2. `GET B/compilations/{id}` 查看 PENDING/PROCESSING/READY/FAILED/PUBLISHED、错误码与用量。
   34     编译不是自动发布。broker 短暂不可用仍保留 PENDING，beat 恢复投递；失败可 `POST .../{id}/retry`。
   35  3. `GET .../{id}/pages` 查看候选页，claims 含原始 document/revision/chunk/locator/quote，relations 是 page_key。
   36     `GET .../{id}/lint` 查看过期、断链、重复、失效来源、缺来源、潜在冲突、内容hash异常。
   37  4. 有 `knowledge_edit` 权限的用户审阅后 `POST .../{id}/publish`。无来源或hash错误阻止发布；冲突是警告，保留两方证据，查询拒绝自动裁决。
   38  5. `POST .../{id}/query`：
   39  
   40     ```json
   41     {"source_snapshot_id":"<编译返回的UUID>","query":"问题",
   42      "mode":"AUTO","intent":"overview","require_current":true}
   43     ```
   44  
   45     返回固定 binding、Wiki 页面、原始 evidence、route、conflicts、insufficient_evidence 与 supplemental_required。
   46     默认 `answer` 是检索摘录，不是完整生成答案。若需要问答，在同一请求追加 `model_profile_id`，
   47     返回 `generated_answer`（answer/citations/telemetry）。生成也必须满足预算、引用范围和逐句引用校验；语义正确性仍需评估。
   48     mode 为 WIKI/RAG/HYBRID/AUTO；intent 为 overview/fact/synthesis。AUTO 的 fact/synthesis 必须回到原始 RAG。
   49     显式 WIKI 是独立阅读/消融模式，证据来自原文摘编，不会偷偷调用原始检索。
   50  6. 新增/修改资料后再次 `POST B/compilations`，默认当前原始 snapshot。未变化 revision 复用提取缓存，
   51     新版原子生成完整页面集；旧 publication 保留。没有自动后台订阅，也不会自动花费模型调用来重编译。
   52     若审阅发现跨别名冲突，可在编译请求里追加 `manual_conflict_groups`，每组 2–8 个
   53     `{"chunk_id":"从pages复制的ID","quote":"从pages复制的准确引文"}`，最多 50 组。
   54     声明必须属于同一来源快照且精确对应已编译引文；形成新版本、复用提取缓存，不能直接修改旧页面。
   55  7. `POST B/sources/{document_revision_id}/revoke` 明确撤销该来源在 **Wiki 范围** 内的使用权，
   56     返回 `scope=WIKI, status=REVOKED`，写入不可删除的 Wiki 撤销记录。
   57     原始 revision 的生命周期和普通 RAG 保持由原知识模块管理；这不是全局知识库删除接口。
   58     任何旧 Wiki 内容查询都不能交付该来源；新编译冻结排除集合，生成去掉该来源的新发布，原始 Snapshot hash 不变。
   59     该操作需要 knowledge_edit，没有恢复端点。Wiki 的 raw fallback 在数据库层过滤撤销集，即使原检索器返回也不交付。
   60     另外，原知识模块已标 DELETED 的来源会自动阻断 Wiki，包括显式历史模式。
   61  
   62  ## 权限和历史
   63  
   64  编译/发布/重试/撤销用现有 knowledge_edit，查询用 knowledge_run；VIEWER 默认没有运行权限。
   65  这些继承现有 RBAC，没有给 READ 工具推导出“安全”权限。没有新增可由模型执行的维护工具。
   66  页面读取也检查来源有效性。require_current=false 是显式历史读取，允许 RETIRED，仍拒绝撤销来源。
   67  默认 current 会因新增、更新、退役、跨文档 supersede 而返回 WIKI_STALE，不把旧摘编伪装成当前知识。
   68  
   69  现有 AgentVersion/Run/正式 Experiment 不自动读取 Wiki。本分支交付独立 API 与 stable retriever adapter；
   70  未来原生工具接入必须先把 WikiBinding 固定到发布规格、Run 与 Experiment，不可绕过 ToolPolicy、预算、snapshot/hash 和审计。
   71  
   72  ## 容量和质量边界
   73  
   74  首版 IO 上限为 2000 个 chunk，单次 revision 提取结果最多 100 个 claim；
   75  最终跨来源复核上限为整次 200 条 claim，以先到达者为准，超限明确失败。
   76  单个chunk太大不截断后假称完整编译；窗口不足会失败。生产批量大资料需要后续分批/检查点设计。
   77  增量节省的是模型提取；页面组装和 lint 仍检查完整来源集，尚未为大图做性能优化。
   78  候选语义分类、别名与冲突召回依赖模型。确定性规则比较同主题/谓词/条件的不同值；
   79  跨来源复核只提出既有引文的冲突 ID 组，版本和提示冻结，不裁决哪方为真。
   80  只有显式 MODEL 模式每次新编译最多增加一次全局复核调用；来源未变的重复请求返回同一任务，复核升级不重提取未变 revision。
   81  当前 DeepSeek 的两次真实跨来源复核均因无效/截断输出失败，MODEL 路径尚未通过真实验收，默认关闭。
   82  编辑者声明和确定性冲突检查可用；它们不证明自动语义冲突召回率。
   83  精确 quote 不证明概念归组或语义推断正确。所有派生知识保留原始证据和不确定状态，禁止递归提升为权威原始来源。
   84  来源的 effective_date 暂只随原有原始 evidence 展示，不作自动时效裁决；未实现别名消歧、复杂图推理、自动真伪裁决。

   19  
   20  AGENT_RUN = "agent_run"
   21  
   22  NOT_FOUND = "ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND"
   23  NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE = "The artifact was not found."
   24  
   25  MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 300
   26  DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 50
   27  MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 200
   28  
   29  
   30  def _workspace_id(context: WorkspaceExecutionContext) -> UUID:
   31      try:
   32          return UUID(context.workspace_id)
   33      except (TypeError, ValueError):
   34          raise AgentHubError("INVALID_WORKSPACE", "Workspace context is invalid.", 500) from None
   35  
   36  
   37  def _principal_id(context: WorkspaceExecutionContext) -> UUID:
   38      try:
   39          if context.user_id is None:
   40              raise ValueError
   41          return UUID(context.user_id)
   42      except (TypeError, ValueError):
   43          raise AgentHubError("AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED", "Authentication is required.", 401) from None
   44  
   45  
   46  def _require(context: WorkspaceExecutionContext, permission: str) -> UUID:
   47      if permission not in context.permissions:
   48          raise AgentHubError("FORBIDDEN", "You do not have permission.", 403)
   49      return _workspace_id(context)

   51  
   52  def _not_found() -> NoReturn:

   54  
   55  
   56  def _validated_title(value: str) -> str:
   57      title = value.strip()
   58      if not title or len(title) > MAX_TITLE_LENGTH:
   59          raise AgentHubError("ARTIFACT_INVALID", "The artifact title is invalid.", 422)
   60      return title
   61  
   62  
   63  class ArtifactService:
   64      def __init__(self, session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]) -> None:
   65          self.session_factory = session_factory
   66  
   67      async def list_for_thread(
   68          self,
   69          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
   70          thread_id: UUID,
   71          *,
   72          artifact_type: str | None = None,
   73          limit: int = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
   74          offset: int = 0,
   75      ) -> list[Artifact]:
   76          workspace_id = _require(context, WORKSPACE_READ)
   77          bounded = max(1, min(limit, MAX_PAGE_SIZE))
   78          async with self.session_factory() as session:
   79              await self._require_thread(session, workspace_id, thread_id)
   80              query = select(Artifact).where(
   81                  Artifact.workspace_id == workspace_id, Artifact.thread_id == thread_id
   82              )
   83              if artifact_type is not None:
   84                  query = query.where(Artifact.type == artifact_type)
   85              query = (
   86                  query.order_by(Artifact.created_at.desc(), Artifact.id.desc())
   87                  .limit(bounded)
   88                  .offset(max(offset, 0))
   89              )
   90              return list(await session.scalars(query))
   91  
   92      async def get(self, context: WorkspaceExecutionContext, artifact_id: UUID) -> Artifact:
   93          workspace_id = _require(context, WORKSPACE_READ)
   94          async with self.session_factory() as session:
   95              return await self._load(session, workspace_id, artifact_id)
   96  
   97      async def create(
   98          self,
   99          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
  100          thread_id: UUID,
  101          *,
  102          artifact_type: str,
  103          title: str,
  104          content: Any,
  105      ) -> Artifact:
  106          workspace_id = _require(context, AGENT_RUN)
  107          created_by = _principal_id(context)
  108          clean_title = _validated_title(title)
  109          # Validate before touching the thread, so a bad body never costs a
  110          # lookup, and never lands half-written.
  111          validated = validate_artifact_content(artifact_type, content)
  112          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  113              await self._require_thread(session, workspace_id, thread_id)
  114              artifact = Artifact(
  115                  workspace_id=workspace_id,
  116                  thread_id=thread_id,
  117                  run_id=None,
  118                  type=artifact_type,
  119                  title=clean_title,
  120                  content=validated,
  121                  created_by=created_by,
  122              )
  123              session.add(artifact)
  124              await session.commit()
  125              await session.refresh(artifact)
  126              return artifact
  127  
  128      async def update(
  129          self,
  130          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
  131          artifact_id: UUID,
  132          *,
  133          title: str | None = None,
  134          content: Any | None = None,
  135      ) -> Artifact:
  136          workspace_id = _require(context, AGENT_RUN)
  137          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  138              artifact = await self._load(session, workspace_id, artifact_id)
  139              await self._retain_handoff_evidence(session, artifact)
  140              if artifact.run_id is not None:
  141                  # An agent-produced artifact is the record of one execution.
  142                  # Editing it would make it no longer a record. The user saves
  143                  # their own copy instead, which has no run.
  144                  raise AgentHubError(
  145                      "ARTIFACT_NOT_EDITABLE",
  146                      "An artifact produced by a run cannot be edited; save a copy instead.",
  147                      409,
  148                  )
  149              if title is not None:
  150                  artifact.title = _validated_title(title)
  151              if content is not None:
  152                  artifact.content = validate_artifact_content(artifact.type, content)
  153              artifact.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
  154              await session.commit()
  155              await session.refresh(artifact)
  156              return artifact
  157  
  158      async def delete(self, context: WorkspaceExecutionContext, artifact_id: UUID) -> None:
  159          workspace_id = _require(context, AGENT_RUN)
  160          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  161              artifact = await self._load(session, workspace_id, artifact_id)
  162              await self._retain_handoff_evidence(session, artifact)
  163              await session.delete(artifact)
  164              await session.commit()
  165  
  166      async def _load(self, session: AsyncSession, workspace_id: UUID, artifact_id: UUID) -> Artifact:
  167          artifact = await session.scalar(
  168              select(Artifact)
  169              .where(Artifact.workspace_id == workspace_id, Artifact.id == artifact_id)
  170              .with_for_update()
  171          )
  172          if artifact is None:
  173              _not_found()
  174          return artifact
  175  
  176      async def _retain_handoff_evidence(self, session: AsyncSession, artifact: Artifact) -> None:
  177          existing = await session.scalar(
  178              select(HandoffCase.id).where(
  179                  HandoffCase.workspace_id == artifact.workspace_id,
  180                  HandoffCase.source_artifact_id == artifact.id,

   19  
   20  _FINISHED = ("SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED", "NEEDS_ATTENTION")
   21  _RUN_STATUSES = frozenset(
   22      {
   23          "RUNNING",
   24          "WAITING_APPROVAL",
   25          "SUCCEEDED",
   26          "FAILED",
   27          "NEEDS_ATTENTION",
   28          "CANCEL_REQUESTED",
   29          "CANCELLED",
   30      }
   31  )
   32  _MAX_WINDOW = timedelta(days=90)
   33  _DEFAULT_WINDOW = timedelta(days=7)
   34  _CURRENCIES = frozenset({"USD", "EUR", "CNY", "GBP", "JPY", "CAD", "AUD", "CHF"})
   35  
   36  
   37  def _utc(value: datetime) -> datetime:
   38      if value.tzinfo is None:
   39          raise AgentHubError(
   40              "INVALID_OBSERVABILITY_WINDOW", "Window timestamps must include UTC.", 422
   41          )
   42      return value.astimezone(UTC)
   43  
   44  
   45  def normalize_window(
   46      start: datetime | None,
   47      end: datetime | None,
   48      *,
   49      now: datetime | None = None,
   50  ) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
   51      """Resolve a bounded UTC window without querying an unbounded history."""
   52  
   53      resolved_end = _utc(end) if end is not None else _utc(now or datetime.now(UTC))
   54      resolved_start = _utc(start) if start is not None else resolved_end - _DEFAULT_WINDOW
   55      if resolved_end <= resolved_start:
   56          raise AgentHubError(
   57              "INVALID_OBSERVABILITY_WINDOW", "The window must have a positive duration.", 422
   58          )
   59      if resolved_end - resolved_start > _MAX_WINDOW:
   60          raise AgentHubError(
   61              "INVALID_OBSERVABILITY_WINDOW", "The window cannot exceed 90 days.", 422
   62          )
   63      return resolved_start, resolved_end
   64  
   65  
   66  def _duration_ms_expr() -> Any:
   67      return func.extract("epoch", AgentRun.completed_at - AgentRun.started_at) * 1000
   68  
   69  
   70  def _decimal(value: Any) -> Decimal | None:
   71      if value is None:
   72          return None
   73      return Decimal(str(value))
   74  
   75  
   76  def _float(value: Any) -> float | None:
   77      if value is None:
   78          return None
   79      return round(float(value), 3)
   80  
   81  
   82  def _rate(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
   83      return {
   84          "numerator": numerator,
   85          "denominator": denominator,
   86          "rate": round(numerator / denominator, 6) if denominator else None,
   87      }
   88  
   89  
   90  def _run_filters(
   91      workspace_id: UUID,
   92      start: datetime,
   93      end: datetime,
   94      agent_version_id: UUID | None,
   95  ) -> list[Any]:
   96      filters: list[Any] = [
   97          AgentRun.workspace_id == workspace_id,
   98          AgentRun.started_at >= start,
   99          AgentRun.started_at < end,
  100      ]
  101      if agent_version_id is not None:
  102          filters.append(AgentRun.agent_version_id == agent_version_id)
  103      return filters
  104  
  105  
  106  def _cost_currency(value: Any) -> str | None:
  107      if value is None:
  108          return None
  109      currency = str(value).upper()
  110      return currency if currency in _CURRENCIES else currency[:3]
  111  
  112  
  113  class MetricsQueryService:
  114      """Read-only, tenant-scoped aggregation service for M6-B."""
  115  
  116      def __init__(self, session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]) -> None:
  117          self.session_factory = session_factory
  118  
  119      async def summary(
  120          self,
  121          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
  122          *,
  123          start: datetime | None = None,
  124          end: datetime | None = None,
  125          agent_version_id: UUID | None = None,
  126      ) -> dict[str, Any]:
  127          workspace_id = _require_read(context)
  128          window_start, window_end = normalize_window(start, end)
  129          filters = _run_filters(workspace_id, window_start, window_end, agent_version_id)
  130          duration = _duration_ms_expr()
  131  
  132          run_statement: Select[Any] = select(
  133              func.count(AgentRun.id).filter(AgentRun.status == "SUCCEEDED").label("succeeded"),
  134              func.count(AgentRun.id).filter(AgentRun.status == "FAILED").label("failed"),
  135              func.count(AgentRun.id).filter(AgentRun.status == "CANCELLED").label("cancelled"),
  136              func.count(AgentRun.id)
  137              .filter(AgentRun.status == "NEEDS_ATTENTION")
  138              .label("needs_attention"),
  139              func.count(AgentRun.id).filter(AgentRun.status.in_(_FINISHED)).label("finished"),
  140              func.percentile_cont(0.5)
  141              .within_group(duration)
  142              .filter(AgentRun.completed_at.is_not(None))
  143              .label("p50_duration"),
  144              func.percentile_cont(0.95)
  145              .within_group(duration)
  146              .filter(AgentRun.completed_at.is_not(None))
  147              .label("p95_duration"),
  148              func.avg(duration).filter(AgentRun.completed_at.is_not(None)).label("avg_duration"),
  149              func.count(AgentRun.id)
  150              .filter(AgentRun.completed_at.is_not(None))
  151              .label("latency_sample_count"),
  152              func.avg(AgentRun.total_tokens)
  153              .filter(AgentRun.total_tokens.is_not(None))
  154              .label("avg_tokens"),
  155              func.avg(AgentRun.total_input_tokens)
  156              .filter(AgentRun.total_input_tokens.is_not(None))
  157              .label("avg_input_tokens"),
  158              func.avg(AgentRun.total_output_tokens)
  159              .filter(AgentRun.total_output_tokens.is_not(None))
  160              .label("avg_output_tokens"),
  161              func.avg(AgentRun.total_cached_tokens)
  162              .filter(AgentRun.total_cached_tokens.is_not(None))
  163              .label("avg_cached_tokens"),
  164              func.sum(AgentRun.total_tokens)
  165              .filter(AgentRun.total_tokens.is_not(None))
  166              .label("total_tokens"),
  167              func.count(AgentRun.id)
  168              .filter(AgentRun.total_tokens.is_not(None))
  169              .label("known_usage_count"),
  170              func.count(AgentRun.id)
  171              .filter(AgentRun.total_tokens.is_(None))
  172              .label("unknown_usage_count"),
  173          ).where(*filters)
  174  
  175          current_run_statement = select(
  176              func.count(AgentRun.id).filter(AgentRun.status == "RUNNING").label("running"),
  177              func.count(AgentRun.id)
  178              .filter(AgentRun.status == "WAITING_APPROVAL")
  179              .label("waiting_approval"),
